kmctof.help: Time-of-flight kinetic Monte Carlo with site exclusion: carriers are injected in the source region (pulses), hop with Marcus rates and leave at the sink. Every carrier has its own clock; a hop into an occupied site is a null event (exact). Records first arrival and mean transit time per carrier (as grw), the transient current and the collected fraction

seed.help: Seed; run r uses its own random streams derived from (seed, r), independent of threads

injection.help: Carrier injection: pulses of carriers placed on free source sites (uniform)

shape.help: delta: all carriers at the pulse start; gaussian: times drawn from a Gaussian of standard deviation width (t >= 0); rectangular: uniform over width

waitingtime.help: How waiting times are drawn (KMC engine strategy): exponential (time-homogeneous KMC) or thinning (bound rates and rejection; with the static rates used here a cross-check of exponential). Strategies for time-dependent rates plug in through WaitingTimeStrategy

maxtime.help: Simulated time limit per run (runs stopped by it are reported as censored)

maxevents.help: Limit of proposed hops per run

resultfile.help: Output: main results as 'key value unit' lines (empty: none)

runfile.help: Output: one line per run (empty: none)

current.help: Transient current and collected fraction on a logarithmic time axis
